calibration: later chronological development OOF only; identity/0.5 threshold when insufficient events
eligibility: complete official Q/R orders and podium, resolved identities/teams, reviewed cutoff rosters and completion/availability evidence
exposure: all existing real outcomes have been accessible for source QA; independence from prior unlogged consultation cannot be established; do not call them untouched
final_evaluation: lock model/configuration and seal Q, then race/podium forecasts, before scoring once under a distinct persistent manifest ledger
final_selection: latest four eligible completed 2026 events; no automatic shrinking
history: strictly earlier completed development weekends; fixed pre-block history in final test
optional_features: not required for core eligibility; require observed comparable session data and development-only retention review
preprocessing: fit within each training fold; exclude numeric features entirely missing in that fold, including associated missing flags/counts for unobserved groups
selection: equal-event loss on identical eligible development events for all three strategies; fixed family/strategy tie order
